readerContract.humanQuestion: If Claude no longer asks me to choose Chat or Cowork, what changed and what still needs my decision?
readerContract.promisedPayoff: Know when the merged experience reaches an account, what Manual and Auto mean, and how to start one low-risk personal task.
readerContract.priorKnowledge: No knowledge of Cowork, agents or plan rollout assumed.
readerContract.centralMentalModel: One conversation can shift from answering to carrying out a longer job; the user still sets permissions and checks the result.
readerContract.dailyLifeConnection: Turn a small set of appliance manuals into an editable maintenance checklist.
readerContract.surfaceJob: September 16 private Daily candidate about Claude merging chat and Cowork.
readerContract.desiredFeeling: I can try the new experience without surrendering the important choices.

draftArchitecture.openingJob: Report that the separate Chat/Cowork choice is being removed.
causalSequence: Anthropic begins a staged account rollout.
A single conversation can answer briefly or take a longer multi-step job.
The reader chooses Manual or Auto permissions for the conversation and reviews the result.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: Attach three appliance manuals and request an editable maintenance checklist.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: Before any longer AI task, state allowed inputs, approval points and checks.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Check the permission mode before the longer task begins.
draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: The Story; LAiDIES Read; What This Means for You; Cocktail Party; Class Notes.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: No generic productivity tips, provider workplace example, fictional persona or claim that one interface makes agent work reliable.

humourPlan.noneReason: Dry, restrained product explanation serves the permission choice.

readerQuestions.question: What do Manual and Auto change?
How can I try it on a low-risk personal task?

requiredTerms.meaning: a job that takes several actions instead of one answer

draftArchitecture.presentationPlan: People-free adult editorial illustration: one tablet conversation visually develops into a household checklist beside appliance manuals, with no logos or readable text.

representativeProofPlan.acceptanceOutcome: Reader can explain what merged, identify whether her account has changed and choose a permission mode for a low-risk task.
